rationale: The stock is trading in an extremely compressed intraday range (ATR of $0.025 on 5m bars, total day range of only $0.16) with price pinned near $48.67, well below the acquisition price of $49.75 — a classic merger-arb spread compression scenario. The last five 1-minute candles show virtually no movement, indicating the market has priced in the deal and is waiting for resolution. With the investigation news adding uncertainty but the spread already partially closed, there is no clean directional edge: going long risks the deal falling apart, going short risks the deal closing at $49.75, and the tight range offers insufficient reward relative to the risk given today's already negative P&L and limited loss budget remaining.
